about.title: Adam and his crew
paragraphs: Adams Auto is Adam's shop on West 2nd Street in The Dalles. Locals bring their cars here for honest repairs, and plenty of travelers towed off I-84 have left as fans.
From engine diagnostics and alternators to A/C and Subarus, Adam and his crew figure out what's wrong and get you back on the road.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Adam will get back to you. Or call (541) 370-2890 (Mon–Fri: 9am–5pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Adam will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.intro: Warning lights, strange noises and problems that come and go, tracked down to the real cause so you only pay for the repair you need.
